messages:
jamie: Heads-up — FinRegCo wants EU-only processing for their POC. Requirements they wrote: process and store in eu-west1, failover only to eu-west2, BYOK (customer GCP KMS), no egress outside EU, full sub-processor list + certs. Need a short list of what we can commit for the POC + any blockers and a pricing delta for sales deck. who can help?
alex: quick q — is this for Hosted (fast POC) or are they asking for Dedicated/Private from day 1? that changes BYOK and subproc guarantees.
jamie: they prefer fast POC to validate latency and UX, but legal says BYOK and subproc list are must-haves even for POC. so Hosted preferred if it can meet those constraints.
li: TL;DR: Hosted can do region pin + routing policy to prefer eu-west1 and fallback to eu-west2 only. however BYOK (customer-managed KMS) is not available on Hosted today — BYOK is supported on Dedicated and Private. Hosted can encrypt-at-rest with our keys and restrict data residency, but we can't route KMS calls to customer project in Hosted mode.
li: also: we currently treat logs/telemetry as a sub-processor category. default hosted subprocessors: GCP (compute/storage), Prometheus/Pushgateway (metrics), Honeycomb (observability), Sentry (errors). we can produce an attestation but cannot remove the cloud provider.
li: sample routing policy for POC (put in the request body):
```
{"region_policy": {"type": "preferred","regions": ["eu-west1","eu-west2"],"fallback_only_to": ["eu-west2"],"deny_outside_regions": true}}
```
alex: thanks @li — so options for the customer: 1) Hosted with region_pin + contractual DPA + subproc attestation (no BYOK) 2) Dedicated EU pool + BYOK (supported) 3) Private deployment into customer VPC with BYOK and absolute control. Each higher option increases setup time & cost.
sales-ops: Quick pricing sketch for POC (ballpark): Hosted EU pin — no infra uplift, just usage (we can offer credits for 2 weeks). Dedicated EU pool for POC — ~€12k/month reserved for a small GPU pool, plus BYOK & KMS integration setup fee €6k one-time. Private on-prem / VPC — starts at €45k onboarding + monthly infra + support. BYOK add-on (for Dedicated/Private) ≈ 15% of committed monthly.
maya: Legal note — for Hosted POC we can provide sub-processor list + SOC2 + ISO27001 cert copies. For BYOK claims we need to sign an addendum; BYOK in Dedicated/Private triggers additional audit items. I can send a tailored DPA and subproc attestation.
jamie: is there any technical blocker if we try Hosted POC with customer-provided key material in GCP? sounds like we can't do BYOK there. we need to be explicit to customer.
li: correct — hosted cannot point to customer KMS. If BYOK is non-negotiable, you must pick Dedicated or Private. For POC we sometimes do a hybrid: run inference on Dedicated EU pool and use Hosted control plane for API routing — but that still counts as Dedicated from a compliance perspective.
alex: for the sales deck I'll prepare two slides: 1) Hosted EU pin (fast, no BYOK) with a sample routing policy + attestation timeline, 2) Dedicated/Private (BYOK, KMS integration, pricing) with expected onboarding times.
sales-ops: timeline estimates: Hosted POC docs + attestation — 2 business days. Dedicated small pool provisioning — ~7 business days after contract. BYOK integration + KMS testing — additional 3–5 business days.
maya: I'll attach subproc list + SOC2 to the thread once I get the greenlight from compliance (ETA EOD).
sre-bot: deploy-bot: region-pin config test for eu-west1/eu-west2 — ALL CHECKS PASSED (id: deploy-2200300760) :white_check_mark:
```
config: region_policy: preferred [eu-west1, eu-west2] deny_outside_regions: true
result: routing tests OK, egress check simulated -> blocked to us-central1
```
jamie: great, thanks all. @alex can you drop the two-slide draft + the JSON routing snippet and a one-paragraph selling line for the pricing delta? i'll share with FinRegCo later today.
alex: on it. will post draft here in ~90m.
jamie: thanks — I'll flag legal + customer success to prep the call if they want Dedicated trial. :thumbsup:
